The plain form: The Lighthouse

Into this page: Wikilinks

Spaced, as a vault author writes it: The Lighthouse

Embeds

An embedded asset:

An embedded page with an alias:

An embed is a slot. C4 fills it, and refuses a cross-campaign target outright (ADR 0017), because an embed is an inline and an inline is what would make this page’s HTML depend on another document.

Labels

The label of a link is the author’s own text. It is never a title read from the target, which is what keeps this page’s bytes identical for every reader.
